title: Island map: grounds, coast and destinations
caption: Actual planted grounds, distinct roof groups and pedestrian routes make the drawn map easier to read. Destination coordinates and fast-travel rules are unchanged.

sections.title: Destination controls
sections.caption: Desktop and phone native selection, zoom, keyboard, pause and fast travel passed. Mean cached map painting measured 0.48–0.58 ms over 30 draws at 1000×800; the 3D office planting is byte-identical after sharing its plan. Northern terrain remains outside this map detail pass.
